changes.comment: Add a third gate (author-identity) to the Rush-managed pre-commit hook at common/git-hooks/pre-commit. The new gate mirrors the `commit-metadata` CI job semantics: it requires a well-formed non-local author email, allows *@users.noreply.github.com, and (optionally) rejects any email matching the operator-owned AUTHOR_EMAIL_DENYLIST_REGEX env var. Shortens the feedback loop for author-email misconfigurations from ~5 minutes (CI) to ~100 ms (pre-commit). Semantics deliberately match .github/workflows/ci.yml so local and CI agree on what a valid author identity is. No published package surface changes.
